items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: a clarinet player by the name of Phil Gomez, a Mexican boy.

ctx.x: What was the name of that club where you took the band after you left the Cavern?

The 400 Club. On 6th and (inaudible). We had almost the same personnel. This time it was Alton Redd on drums, Eldridge Cook on piano, "Streamline"; that was his first time playing dixieland, and a clarinet player by the name of Phil Gomez, a Mexican boy.
We stayed there a while and then I went back to the Beverly Cavern and I had another fine band over at the Cavern when I went back. Cook was on piano, Montudie on bass.
